name: Employment Linked Skill Training Programme (ELSTP)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free, self-employment-oriented training courses to unemployed/school dropouts/other disadvantaged youth of the state. It is a state-sponsored scheme that offers training in fields such as IT, healthcare, agriculture, beauty and wellness, electronics, and more.
descriptionMd: The “Employment Linked Skill Training Programme” scheme was launched by the Department of Skill Development and Employment, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free, self-employment-oriented training courses to unemployed/school dropouts/other disadvantaged youth of the state. It is a state-sponsored scheme that offers training in fields such as IT, healthcare, agriculture, beauty and wellness, electronics, and more.
benefitsMd: - This training is free of cost and has a duration of 3 to 6 months. - Training offers employment/self-employment-oriented courses in areas such as IT, health, agriculture, beauty, wellness, electronics, and more. - The training provider also strives to facilitate employment opportunities for participants.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an unemployed, school dropout, or other underprivileged youth of the state.
applicationMd: - Candidates can register for training on the Uttarakhand Skill Development Committee website, [www.uksdm.org](https://www.uksdm.org/), and apply to the private training provider centers listed on the website. - Interested youth can contact the organizations by selecting the relevant job role. The list of active organizations is available on the departmental website. - During the application process, candidates will need to provide their Aadhaar card and educational qualification certificate for the respective course.
